answer: Make the attack boring and expensive, and most attackers go elsewhere. Chiropractor licence with health regulator attestation achieves that with four-year degree, 500 supervised adjustments, board exam, annual renewal. The quartz is the grind: forms, fees, appointments, examinations, repeated over years by a real person. Automating the grind means automating a life, and the signal in that automation is the cost of the props — a thousand convincing details, each one checkable, each one a chance to be caught. The walnut is the checker's checklist: short, cheap, and merciless.
